Her long, dark brown hair is wavy.  She has a serious, yet alluring expression with neutral lips and brown eyes. Her body is slender and toned with a visible cleavage.  She is posed slightly angled towards the viewer, with her head and eyes looking directly at the camera.  She's positioned near a wooden structure or interior wall, with blurred background textures and tones of light beige and brown. The lighting is focused on the subject, with soft shadows around her, creating a dramatic effect. Warm and golden tones dominate the image. The composition is close-up, highlighting the woman's features and attire. The style is suggestive of a photo shoot or fashion portrait,  emphasizing a sultry western aesthetic.  A brown leather belt with a large buckle accents her waist.  The image has a vintage or retro feel.
